the design features and the performances of the distributed data acquisition system developed for the Pachmarhi array of \v{C}erenkov telescopes (PACT), are presented.

the DDAS is capable of recording 25 channels at the rate of 10 kHz/channel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a distributed data acquisition system for the PACT experiment.
the design, construction and operation of a distributed system for the acquisition and analysis of data from the PACT array of telescopes.
